## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(NHANES)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
data("NHANES")

#names(NHANES)
head(NHANES)
#str(NHANES)
#summary(NHANES)

```

#1 AGE DECADE AND EDUCATION ON HOUSEHOLD INCOME (CONTINUOUS) HEATMAP 

shiny ideas: hover on tiles to show proportion of people in each category
```{r}

df <- NHANES |> 
  filter(!is.na(AgeDecade), !is.na(Education), !is.na(HHIncomeMid), !is.na(Gender))

#Heatmap of AgeDecade (Categorical), Education (Categorical), HHIncome (Continuous)
ggplot(df, aes(x = AgeDecade, y = Education, fill = HHIncomeMid)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(title = "Age Decade and Education Level on Household Income",
       x = "Age Decade", 
       y = "Education Level", 
       fill = "Household Income") +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_minimal()

#Heatmap of AgeDecade (Categorical), Education (Categorical), HHIncome (Continuous) stratified by Gender
ggplot(df, aes(x = AgeDecade, y = Education, fill = HHIncomeMid)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender) +
  labs(title = "Age Decade and Education Level on Household Income, Stratified by Gender",
       x = "Age Decade", 
       y = "Education Level", 
       fill = "Household Income") +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_minimal()

#Heatmap of AgeDecade (Categorical), Education (Categorical), HHIncome (Continuous) stratified by Race
ggplot(df, aes(x = AgeDecade, y = Education, fill = HHIncomeMid)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ Race1) +
  labs(title = "Age Decade and Education Level on Household Income, Stratified by Race",
       x = "Age Decade", 
       y = "Education Level", 
       fill = "Household Income") +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_minimal()

#Heatmap of AgeDecade (Categorical), Education (Categorical), HHIncome (Continuous) stratified by Gender and Race
ggplot(df, aes(x = AgeDecade, y = Education, fill = HHIncomeMid)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ Gender +  Race1, nrow= 2) +
  labs(title = "Age Decade and Education Level on Household Income, Stratified by Gender and Race",
       x = "Age Decade", 
       y = "Education Level", 
       fill = "Household Income") +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_minimal()
```
